metric_definitions.passing_offense: Gross passing yards / pass attempts; sack losses added back to net passing yards. Sacks are excluded from both yards and attempts. Higher is better.
metric_definitions.pass_defense: Opponent gross passing yards / opponent pass attempts; sack losses added back, sacks excluded from numerator and denominator. Lower allowed efficiency is better.
metric_definitions.rushing_offense: Rushing yards / rushing carries including all official team rushing attempts. Higher is better.
metric_definitions.run_defense: Opponent rushing yards / opponent rushing attempts. Lower allowed efficiency is better.
metric_definitions.ties: Exact unrounded rational efficiencies use shared competition ranks; ordinal strips use 33-rank, not probabilities.
